verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes JMAP, which batches multiple method calls (query, fetch, send) into one HTTP request and can sync changes in a single roundtrip. Together with API tokens for programmatic access, this lets an AI-native user script multi-item operations. However, the pack never explicitly documents bulk mutation, such as moving, labeling or deleting many messages in one call, and Filters & Rules appears only as a page title. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk update/delete across many items, UI bulk-selection actions, and hands-on or community corroboration of bulk workflows.
